sentences.text:
Smt Kahkehsa Jaha vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 20
February, 2023

Author: Rahul Chaturvedi
Bench: Rahul Chaturvedi
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 67
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 2254 of 2023
Applicant :- Smt Kahkehsa Jaha
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Tarun Jha

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to direct the learned Judicial Magistrate, Konch, District Jalaun to decide the complaint case no.800 of 2017, Smt. Kahkesha vs.
Pyaar Mohammad and others, under Sections 498A, 323 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Konch District Jalaun, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Konch, District Jalaun within stipulated period.

entities.text:
Smt. Kahkesha vs.
Pyaar Mohammad and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Submission made by learned counsel for the applicant is that the matter is pending since 2017and the trial is still in its nascent stage.

Under the circumstances, keeping in view that the matter relates to the year 2017, learned trial court is directed to gear up the matter and make all necessary endeavour to conclude the trial on priority Smt Kahkehsa Jaha vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152513865/
1 basis within a period of one and half years from the date of production of certified copy of this order without granting any unjust, unwarranted and unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties strictly in accordance with law, if there is no legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, this 482 Cr.P.C. application is finally disposed of.
Order Date :- 20.2.2023 SP  Smt Kahkehsa Jaha vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152513865/
